identity_description: Nonblank native string id identifies a network configuration. routeId is a separate reference, version a configuration version.
limitations: List POST /api/ai/decision/network/queryDecisionNetwork.json only {rowStart:0,pageSize:5000}; native data.totalCount must equal unique arrivals within the one fixed page.
Keep the original 26 network settings fields. Exclude dynamic statistics, personnel, free text, action payloads and unknown root fields. Verify conflicting native IDs before projection.

Get root POST /api/ai/decision/network/detail.json with exact id. History POST /api/ai/decision/network/queryLog.json uses selected root creditAliasName/debitAliasName arrays and fundAction; no global history query.

History completes at the entire successfully returned native array, including empty arrays; no total, extra pagination or proof of unseen backend versions is required. Preserve source IDs/versions and context validation. Root and history keep their independent native values; same-ID field differences do not make the result incomplete. No snapshot pinning or atomicity claim.

Applicable route quota GET /queryWhaleRouteDetail.json uses root routeId/debitAliasName and fixed GUAPW3SG; missing context remains unverified, explicit null/empty routeId is inapplicable. No optional drop of applicable associations.
Keep route quota arrays, nested native values and blank/repeated child quotaId. Nonempty returned context must match; request context is not fabricated in native output.

Get returns assembled root plus operationHistory and routeDetails; query_evidence coverage retains separate component status and sequential-read limitations. Any actual required inquiry failure aborts. Get never publishes or imports.

List live does not publish; accepted nonempty Refresh publishes the settings source only. Qualified incomplete acquisition may publish by default; --require-complete rejects it. Failed, strict-rejected and empty Refresh preserve the saved List. No list-with-detail binding. Durable publication requires explicit sync.

sync.evidence: Nonblank native string id identifies a network configuration. routeId is a separate reference, version a configuration version. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
